claims.claim: ADA Title II web accessibility compliance deadlines for state and local governments
claims.value: April 26, 2027 for entities with populations of 50,000 or more; April 26, 2028 for entities under 50,000 and special districts
claims.sourceTitle: ADA.gov — Fact Sheet: New Rule on the Accessibility of Web Content and Mobile Apps Provided by State and Local Governments

claims.claim: IRS automatic revocation after required annual filings are missed for three consecutive years
claims.value: Tax-exempt status is automatically revoked effective on the original filing due date of the third consecutive annual return or notice
